boss-kill.name: Mission (boss kill)
boss-kill.assign: auto on approach; green speech-bubble villagers point to it
boss-kill.repeat: regenerate daily / on sleep; marker vanishes when done
notes: mission bosses (saurian) drop no spirit cube

quests-cut.name: Procedural quests
quests-cut.desc: 2011-12 kill/find quests with generated text (EN/DE), quest region on minimap; cut Jan 2013 ('could remove freedom, repetitive'); pre-2019 concept: quest log, rarity-coloured quests, Old Man giver, amulet fetch, Drolu herbs cauldron

_shared.discover: talk to villagers/adventurers or read lore → marker (may be far); tier hidden (white text) until visited on foot
_shared.reward: gear one rarity above tier + coins + 1 potion + gems
_shared.repeat: most daily (inn reset works); gnomes/books once per land

combat-encounter.name: Combat / Invasion / Boss fight
combat-encounter.desc: kill group + boss; factions fighting each other; necromancers raising undead; captives; destroy spawn structures

gnome-supplier.name: Gnome Supplier rescue
gnome-supplier.desc: boss holds key or freed on objective; unlocks shop rarity

artifact-dungeon.name: Artifact dungeon
artifact-dungeon.desc: land's ultimate goal; parkour, enemies green→yellow, multiple bosses; may need key items

key-item.name: Special / key item
key-item.desc: reins need no fight; NPC hint places floating icon on map

spawner.name: Molehill / Bone pile / Hornet nest / Slime well
